title: Hundreds of Protests Across France; Paris March From Porte d'Italie
detail: Hundreds of demonstrations were expected across France on 24 October, with shops, businesses and tourist sites reported closed. In Paris the march sets off from Porte d'Italie at 14:00 on the prefecture-imposed route toward Porte de Vincennes, which remains the only authorised route after the administrative court rejected an appeal.

media.caption: Live coverage of 24 October demonstrations in France

title: Decree Published to Release Strategic Diesel Stocks Amid Fuel Price Pressure
detail: A decree releasing part of France's strategic diesel reserves was published in the Journal officiel as the government responds to pressure on fuel prices.

title: Bardella Re-elected RN President with 98.98% of Votes at Orléans Congress
detail: Jordan Bardella, the sole candidate, was re-elected president of the Rassemblement National with 98.98% of votes at the party congress in Orléans.

title: Police Fire Teargas at Protesters in Toulouse and Lyon
detail: Police fired teargas at demonstrators in Toulouse and Lyon as hundreds of protests took place across France amid high tensions and heavy police presence.
